title: Arranged vs Love Marriage
summary: In South Asia, arranged marriages are introduced through families; love marriages start from a couple's own relationship. Many modern marriages mix both, and either can work when there's consent, respect and compatibility.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
